signal: EliseAI launched Agent by EliseAI, a mobile app extending EliseCRM to leasing teams on the go

email.body1:
Alexandra, saw EliseAI launched Agent, the mobile app extending EliseCRM to leasing teams on the move.

A launch like that usually surfaces more operators than the team can work before the interest cools, and that overflow is pipeline left behind. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for EliseAI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Alexandra, quick follow-up for EliseAI.

As you own sales productivity, you know coverage and rep time are the real constraints, yet most teams don't know how many meetings it takes to hit the number. So the gap surfaces late while reps lose hours to research and CRM.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings EliseAI needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Alexandra, last bit of proof for EliseAI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how EliseAI's reply rate likely compares to other proptech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Alexandra, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out a new app is its own kind of busy, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a sales-productivity lens? I'll tailor it to EliseAI either way.
